extra.message: User input from request.GET['host'] is concatenated directly into an OS command executed via os.system(). This allows command injection, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.

User input from request.GET['name'] is used directly in a file path construction without sanitization. This allows path traversal attacks allowing attackers to write files to arbitrary locations on the filesystem.
User-controlled input from request.body and request.GET['blob'] is passed to pickle.loads() without validation. This allows arbitrary code execution through Python object deserialization.
User input from request.GET['expr'] is passed directly to eval() function. Even with restricted builtins, this allows code injection and arbitrary code execution.
User-controlled input from request.GET['lane'] and request.POST['lane'] is passed directly to redirect() without validation. This allows open redirect attacks for phishing.

extra.message: XML parser is configured with load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=True, and no_network=False, which enables XML External Entity (XXE) attacks. User-controlled XML input can read arbitrary files or make network requests.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: User-controlled input from request body is passed directly to MongoDB find_one() query. This allows NoSQL injection attacks to bypass authentication or exfiltrate data.

extra.message: SSL certificate verification is disabled using ssl._create_unverified_context(). This makes the application vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks.
